$description: Marker design tokens v1.2 (Nov 2026): brand layer (color, type, space, radius, shadow, motion, layout) and product layer (scale, ui.light/ui.dark, product). Format: W3C DTCG. Edit this file only, then run `python tools/build_tokens.py` and `python tools/validate_docs.py`.

persimmon.$description: Primary accent. Emphasis, data highlights, progress, the quote card. Large text only when used as text colour on white (3.4:1).

lime.$description: Highlighter. Sits behind 1–4 key words per headline, and fills the closing CTA band. Always with ink text.

beige.$description: Supporting accent for illustrations, chips and data series.

green.$description: Supporting accent. Doubles as the positive/success colour.

pink.$description: Supporting accent for illustrations and data series. Use sparingly.

sky.$description: Supporting accent for illustration and data only (the 'in progress' state in How-it-works step 3). Never for text, UI or backgrounds.

default.$description: Dark ink. Primary text, page shell, logo tile. Replaces the legacy #17201B.

secondary.$description: Secondary text. Absorbs #525252 / #535353 from the build.

tertiary.$description: Captions, meta, labels on light surfaces (AA on page and white).

muted.$description: De-emphasised half of two-tone headlines, 24px+ only (3.3:1 on page). Replaces #8F8F8F, which measured 2.99:1 and failed even the large-text minimum.

inverse.$description: Primary text on dark and black surfaces.

inverse-secondary.$description: Secondary text on dark and black surfaces.

chip.$description: Pills, tabs, section-badge fills on light.

dark.$description: Primary button fill, dark UI chrome.

shell.$description: Page frame behind the rounded sections (same value as ink.default).

inverse.$description: Dark storytelling sections (Problem, Solution, Who we are).

default.$description: Component outlines on light surfaces (Figma variable color/border).

inverse.$description: Hairlines and card outlines on dark and black surfaces.

neutral.$description: Greys. Existing brand neutrals, plus 350 for dark-theme tertiary text.

beige.$description: 300 = brand Beige. Darker steps double as the warning family.

red.$description: Error / destructive family (product only, never decorative).

persimmon-fade.$description: The one brand gradient. Quote card, app icon, posters. Never on buttons or full-section backgrounds.

mono.$description: Product only: IDs, logs, code, aligned numbers.

display-xl.$description: 72px desktop / 40px mobile. Slides, billboards, oversized hero moments.

display-l.$description: 56px / 36px. Web H1 and section H2. Replaces the build's 54px and 60px sizes.

display-s.$description: 32px / 24px, Light. Pull quotes, two-tone narrative paragraphs, footer CTA cards.

button.$description: 14px, uppercase. Button labels (the build still uses Archivo Medium; migrate to this).

label.$description: 12px Geist, uppercase. Section badges, eyebrows, table labels.

micro.$description: 10px. Only inside hero metric chips and diagrams — never for reading text.

lg.$description: Large containers: CTA panel, footer card, page-shell corners.

pill.$description: Chips, badges, metric pills. Absorbs 47px and the 5950/6854px Figma values.

shell-gutter.$description: Dark page-shell inset around every section.

section-padding-x.$description: Horizontal section padding: 20px at 390px wide, 80px at 1440px.

canvas-max.$description: Design canvas width. Sections may go full-bleed beyond it.

control-height.$description: Visual height of buttons and tabs.

tap-target.$description: Minimum hit area on touch. Reach it with min-height on mobile or an invisible ::after, not by changing the visual 40px.

icon-md.$description: Link-card corner arrow, badge icon tile, social icons.

connector-node.$description: Persimmon square node on connector lines.

base.$description: Mobile design frame (Figma 1:72579). Mobile-first base styles — not a min-width query, so it is not emitted to Tailwind (keep Tailwind's default sm = 640px).

md.$description: Tablet. Not designed yet — derive, then design.

lg.$description: Small laptop. Two-column layouts start here.

inset-press.$description: Pressed / hover state for link cards.

pressed.$description: The pressed panel: recessed from the sheet in both themes.

shell.$description: The ink frame around the app (sidebar + gutter), as on the website.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind dialogs and the mobile drawer, used at 56% opacity.

on-shell.$description: Text and focus ring on the ink frame.

on-shell-muted.$description: Secondary text on the ink frame.

status.$description: Success / warning / danger / info / neutral. Always pair with an icon and a label.

chart.$description: Chart colours. Categorical slots 1-6 in fixed order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into "other". Validated (Machado 2009 CVD sim): worst adjacent CVD dE 9.2, normal-vision dE 19.8.

pressed.$description: The pressed panel: recessed from the sheet in both themes.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind dialogs and the mobile drawer, used at 56% opacity.

on-shell.$description: Text and focus ring on the ink frame.

on-shell-muted.$description: Secondary text on the ink frame.

product.$description: Product (app UI) layer for Marker Command Center. See PRODUCT.md.

type.$description: Dense product type scale (app UI). Marketing pages keep `type`.

control-sm.$description: Compact buttons/inputs in toolbars and tables.

control-lg.$description: Prominent actions; same as the marketing control height.

row.$description: Table row, default density (also the touch target).

icon-sm.$description: Icons in controls and table cells.

gutter.$description: Page padding and grid gutter (16px below md).
